newsitem.title: UK: Organisers set dates for UK's Farnborough air show.
newsitem.headline: Organisers set dates for UK's Farnborough air show.

text.p: The organiser of Britain's biennial Farnborough International air show gave notice on Wednesday that it is to break with tradition after next year's show and will stage the event in future in July rather than early September.
The Society of British Aerospace Companies (SBAC) said in a statement that the show will take place on September 7-13 next year, but the year 2000's event will be held on July 24-30.
The SBAC said the show is to be held earlier in the year to even the gap with the Paris airshow, which is traditionally held every other year in June.

"Overseas exhibitors generally argued that the traditional eight/nine-month gap between the alternating Farnborough and Paris shows and then the longer 15-month gap...needed to be rationalised to a more evenly-spaced one-year difference," the SBAC said.
